title: nan
authors: Xu Z.; Zhong X.; Wang N.; Hu H.; Liu Q.
key_contribution: Presents VG-Fusion, a visual geo-localization method fused with IMU and LiDAR-inertial odometry via factor graph optimization for UAVs in GNSS-denied field environments, validated on public and own datasets.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
